title: FeedbackEvent
description: One structured event from the in-app review loop (or a submission outcome, or a measured review session). The atomic unit of the flywheel: section type × claim tier × edit reason routes each event to its learning target. Edit-survival telemetry is computed directly from these, and reviewer-effort events supply the human side of the blended cost model (../reporting/REPORTING_SPEC.md).

revision.description: Which draft revision this event occurred on.

actor.description: Reviewer identity (for attribution, not blame). Never an aggregation key in any view outside the reviewer's own screen.

actor_role.description: Role of the actor. Required for cost attribution — a partner-hour and a coordinator-hour differ by 4–6×, and effort is aggregated by role, never by named person. external_reviewer (E6, B37): a guest commenting through a share link — folding externals into `other` would silently pool untrusted-provenance signal with internal firm roles, the one aggregation the trust model must keep separable.

kind.description: comment = inline instruction to the Revision Agent; edit = direct human text change; accept/reject = disposition of an agent revision; waive_block = human overrode a Tier-1 block (always logged); outcome = pursuit-level win/loss result; review_session = a measured span of human time on task (effort block required).

section_type.description: Normalized section category (e.g. exec_summary, methodology, ocm, pricing_narrative) — the aggregation key for edit-survival and Playbook lessons.

claim_tier.description: Tier of the claim(s) touched, when applicable.

edit_reason.description: Why the human intervened. THE routing signal: factual → Fact Sheet/corpus correction; tone → voice spec; length/structure → Playbook drafting guidance; strategy → win-theme/planning lessons; compliance → validation-stack tuning.

cid.description: The pending-store id (cmt_NNNN) a finalized comment/edit event consumed (P26a, P1-14): a replayed round commit dedupes on it, so the append-only record carries each consumed item exactly once.

agent_reply.description: Revision Agent's response to the comment.

outcome.description: kind=outcome only: the pursuit result, back-labels every corpus entry from this pursuit.

effort.description: kind=review_session: measured human time on task. The missing input to the blended cost model — reviewer hours dominate engine spend by orders of magnitude and cannot be reconstructed after the fact, so this must be capturing before the pilot. Passive by default; the reviewer is never asked to fill in a timesheet.

active_ms.description: Foreground, focused time with the review surface open, idle-timed-out after 90s of no interaction. Estimated, and labeled as such wherever displayed.

measurement.description: passive = UI-measured; confirmed = reviewer accepted or adjusted the pre-filled figure at gate close; manual = entered for offline work (the marked-up printout on a plane).

confirmed_minutes.description: The reviewer's figure at gate close, pre-filled with the passive measurement. Accepting the default is one click — this is the only effort field a human ever touches.

scope.description: What the session covered. Gate and gap-answer scopes join to run-log gate.wait_ms and gap records. document_prep (P13/C17, B51's carrier; spec N1/R3) = human time preparing buyer documents for the engine (transcribing matrices, retyping tables, cleaning scans) — the cost the extraction layer exists to remove, and unmeasurable once it has been removed: the scope must exist BEFORE the pilot or the baseline is gone forever.

flywheel_routing.description: Set by the Feedback Learner after processing.

then.description: B9: 'effort block required' was prose-only; a review_session without effort is an unrecoverable measurement lost (R3).
